tools.name: orbit
tools.description:
orbit: your asks to dima on the fleet board; an ask goes here, never into a reply. 🛎️ tick = pick good to go, 🔁 replay = another round, plus his steer; marked asks reach you model-only. a --bg session has no board: its asks go to its coordinator.
op add, asks [{ text, pick, hiddenNote, link }]: text one line ≤90 chars, subject first, readable alone (no «above», «this»); pick: your recommendation; hiddenNote: yours alone, its source and what a tick means; link: one https url or file path he opens in a click; dies: "halt" or N of dima's prompts unpicked, your own turns never count. irreversible (trash, push, close, merge) → lead with ⚠️, name the exact target.
op resolve, ids, words { id: closing word }: the asks answered this turn; they leave when it ends, a worded one shown dim a turn more.
op follow, id, text, pick: another round on an answered ask, same id and place, text ≤90 chars, marked 🆕.
op assume, texts: ≤3 a turn, ≤90 chars: unasked choices a wrong guess would cost a redo on, never routine; 🛎️ clears, ↩️ sends back with his steer.
op catch, pieces [{ kind, text, hiddenNote }], clear [ids]: cclio only, her rules come from catch.md.
op plan, lines: your next 7 moves (now, next, then), each ≤90 chars and readable alone; set at each turn end; untouched 3 turns reads stale. step: your lane step.
op glide — 🦉 cclio only, every board draws it: act create, title, items [{ text, ticket, done }]: a lane's whole scope as 1–7 steps dima reads at a glance — plain words, ≤60 chars, no paths, op names or pr numbers; ticket is an optional id; the result names the lane id. act link, id, session, role (coder or verifier): a member's session id; a re-link of a role replaces the old one. act edit, id, title?, items?: the card refreshed in place, a step whose text stays keeps its done flag. act step, id, current: the step we are on, every step before it done; current = the step count marks the lane finished. act end, id: at the siesta or the halt after it finished. nothing moved for 8 of your turns reads stale.
